```{=html}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
```

![](/images/uq1.jpg){width="100%"}

LADAL tools are self-contained Shiny applications that run in your browser — no installation of R or any other software is required. Click a launch button on any tool card below, wait for the environment to load (typically 1–2 minutes on first launch), and start working with your own texts.

## How to Launch {#how-to-launch}

Each tool card offers three launch options. Choose the one that applies to you:

```{=html}
<div class="launch-info">
  <div class="launch-option opt1">
    <div class="lo-label">&#x2B50; Option 1 &mdash; Recommended</div>
    <h4>ARDC BinderHub</h4>
    <p>Hosted by the <a href="https://ardc.edu.au">Australian Research Data Commons</a> on the NeCTAR Research Cloud. Generous computing resources and reliable performance.</p>
    <span class="access-note restricted">&#x1F512; AU &amp; NZ university accounts only &mdash; requires AAF or Tuakiri login</span>
  </div>
  <div class="launch-option opt2">
    <div class="lo-label">Option 2</div>
    <h4>ATAP BinderHub</h4>
    <p>Hosted by the <a href="https://atap.edu.au">Australian Text Analytics Platform</a>. An alternative AU/NZ institutional server with equivalent functionality.</p>
    <span class="access-note restricted">&#x1F512; AU &amp; NZ university accounts only &mdash; requires AAF or Tuakiri login</span>
  </div>
  <div class="launch-option opt3">
    <div class="lo-label">&#x1F310; Option 3 &mdash; Open Access</div>
    <h4>MyBinder.org</h4>
    <p>Free and open &mdash; no account or login of any kind required. Works for users anywhere in the world. May be slower with lower resource limits than Options 1 and 2.</p>
    <span class="access-note open">&#x2713; Open to everyone &mdash; no login needed</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Text Preparation Tools {#preparation-tools}

```{=html}
<p class="tool-group-desc">These tools help you prepare and pre-process your texts before analysis — cleaning, annotating, and organising your files.</p>
<div class="tool-cards-grid">

  <!-- FileRenamer -->
  <div class="tool-card">
    <div class="tool-card-header h5">
      <div class="tool-icon">&#x270F;&#xFE0F;</div>
      <div class="tool-card-header-text">
        <h3>FileRenamer</h3>
        <p>Batch rename plain-text files</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tool-card-body">
      <p>Rename multiple plain-text files in bulk using find-and-replace patterns, numbering schemes, or prefix/suffix rules. Useful for standardising filenames before corpus analysis.</p>
      <a href="/tutorials/string/string.html" class="tool-learn-link">&#x2192; String Processing Tutorial</a>
      <div class="card-launch-btns">
        <div class="card-launch-row">
          <span class="card-launch-label">Option 1</span>
          <a class="card-btn ardc" href="https://binderhub.rc.nectar.org.au/v2/gh/SLCLADAL/tools-env/main?urlpath=git-pull%3Frepo%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fgithub.com%252FSLCLADAL%252Ftools%26urlpath%3Dvoila%252Frender%252Ftools%252Ffilerenamer_launcher.ipynb%26branch%3Dmain">ARDC BinderHub</a>
        </div>
        <div class="card-launch-row">
          <span class="card-launch-label">Option 2</span>
          <a class="card-btn atap" href="https://binderhub.atap-binder.cloud.edu.au/v2/gh/SLCLADAL/tools-env/main?urlpath=git-pull%3Frepo%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fgithub.com%252FSLCLADAL%252Ftools%26urlpath%3Dvoila%252Frender%252Ftools%252Ffilerenamer_launcher.ipynb%26branch%3Dmain">ATAP BinderHub</a>
        </div>

          <span class="card-launch-label">Option 3</span>
          <a class="card-btn mybinder" href="https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/SLCLADAL/tools-env/main?urlpath=git-pull%3Frepo%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fgithub.com%252FSLCLADAL%252Ftools%26urlpath%3Dlab%252Ftree%252Ftools%252Ffilerenamer_launcher.ipynb%26branch%3Dmain">MyBinder.org</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TextCleaner -->
  <div class="tool-card">

      <a href="/tutorials/string/string.html" class="tool-learn-link">&#x2192; String Processing Tutorial</a>
      <div class="card-launch-btns">
        <div class="card-launch-row">
          <span class="card-launch-label">Option 1</span>
          <a class="card-btn ardc" href="https://binderhub.rc.nectar.org.au/v2/gh/SLCLADAL/tools-env/main?urlpath=git-pull%3Frepo%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fgithub.com%252FSLCLADAL%252Ftools%26urlpath%3Dvoila%252Frender%252Ftools%252Ftextcleaner_launcher.ipynb%26branch%3Dmain">ARDC BinderHub</a>
        </div>
        <div class="card-launch-row">
          <span class="card-launch-label">Option 2</span>
          <a class="card-btn atap" href="https://binderhub.atap-binder.cloud.edu.au/v2/gh/SLCLADAL/tools-env/main?urlpath=git-pull%3Frepo%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fgithub.com%252FSLCLADAL%252Ftools%26urlpath%3Dvoila%252Frender%252Ftools%252Ftextcleaner_launcher.ipynb%26branch%3Dmain">ATAP BinderHub</a>

  <!-- POSTagger -->
```

## Text Analysis Tools {#analysis-tools}

```{=html}
<p class="tool-group-desc">These tools perform linguistic and statistical analysis on your texts — from concordancing and collocation to sentiment, topic modelling, and network visualisation.</p>
<div class="tool-cards-grid">

  <!-- WordFinder -->
  <div class="tool-card">
    <div class="tool-card-header">
      <div class="tool-icon">&#x1F50D;</div>
      <div class="tool-card-header-text">
        <h3>WordFinder</h3>
        <p>Keyword-in-context concordancing</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tool-card-body">
      <p>Search for words or phrases across uploaded texts and generate KWIC (Keyword-in-Context) displays. Results can be sorted by left or right context and downloaded as Excel or CSV.</p>
      <a href="/tutorials/concordancing_tutorial/concordancing_tutorial.html" class="tool-learn-link">&#x2192; Concordancing Tutorial</a>
      <div class="card-launch-btns">
        <div class="card-launch-row">
          <span class="card-launch-label">Option 1</span>
          <a class="card-btn ardc" href="https://binderhub.rc.nectar.org.au/v2/gh/SLCLADAL/tools-env/main?urlpath=git-pull%3Frepo%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fgithub.com%252FSLCLADAL%252Ftools%26urlpath%3Dvoila%252Frender%252Ftools%252Fwordfinder_launcher.ipynb%26branch%3Dmain">ARDC BinderHub</a>
        </div>
        <div class="card-launch-row">
          <span class="card-launch-label">Option 2</span>
          <a class="card-btn atap" href="https://binderhub.atap-binder.cloud.edu.au/v2/gh/SLCLADAL/tools-env/main?urlpath=git-pull%3Frepo%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fgithub.com%252FSLCLADAL%252Ftools%26urlpath%3Dvoila%252Frender%252Ftools%252Fwordfinder_launcher.ipynb%26branch%3Dmain">ATAP BinderHub</a>
        </div>
        <div class="card-launch-row">
          <span class="card-launch-label">Option 3</span>
          <a class="card-btn mybinder" href="https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/SLCLADAL/tools-env/main?urlpath=git-pull%3Frepo%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fgithub.com%252FSLCLADAL%252Ftools%26urlpath%3Dlab%252Ftree%252Ftools%252Fwordfinder_launcher.ipynb%26branch%3Dmain">MyBinder.org</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- KeywordExtractor -->
  <div class="tool-card">
    <div class="tool-card-header h2">
      <div class="tool-icon">&#x1F511;</div>

      <div class="card-launch-btns">
        <div class="card-launch-row">

        </div>
        <div class="card-launch-row">
          <span class="card-launch-label">Option 2</span>
          <a class="card-btn atap" href="https://binderhub.atap-binder.cloud.edu.au/v2/gh/SLCLADAL/tools-env/main?urlpath=git-pull%3Frepo%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fgithub.com%252FSLCLADAL%252Ftools%26urlpath%3Dvoila%252Frender%252Ftools%252Fkeywordextractor_launcher.ipynb%26branch%3Dmain">ATAP BinderHub</a>
        </div>
        <div class="card-launch-row">
          <span class="card-launch-label">Option 3</span>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- WordWebber -->
  <div class="tool-card">
    <div class="tool-card-header h3">
      <div class="tool-icon">&#x1F578;&#xFE0F;</div>
      <div class="tool-card-header-text">
        <h3>WordWebber</h3>
        <p>Word co-occurrence network visualisation</p>

        </div>
```
